title: PARDUS SUPER SPORT—105 HDB original-generation specification
notes: The still-live manufacturer page identifies the original SUPER SPORT—105 HDB, not Super Sport Gen 2. It specifies an HS-EPS carbon frame, HS-HPT carbon fork, Shimano 105 R7020 hydraulic disc brakes, 11-speed R7000 gearing with a 50/34T crank and 11–28T cassette, a carbon cockpit and six sizes. It publishes no complete-bike weight, maximum tire clearance or controlled stiffness result.
